paper_records.saved_takeaway: PCL combines summed peer CE, feature-concatenation teacher CE, ensemble-to-peer KD and EMA-peer KD. Shared low layers and private high layers receive both hard losses, while individual peer classifier heads bypass fusion teacher CE and a separate fusion classifier receives it. Direct partial block-loss routing prior, not exact shared-pool/private-own split. Default one EMA peer; optional EMA feature-fusion ensemble.
paper_records.gradient_scaling: Eq2 summed peer hard CE has no1/M. Eq5 omega*T² summed ensemble KL; Eq9 omega*T²/(M-1) sums peer-source KL, averaging other teachers per student rather than students. Hard features receive B_i^T(p_i-y)+A_i^T(p_t-y); individual B_i only direct own hard CE plus KD.
